messages:
morgan: Starting a config-only rollout to nudge batching/timeouts/routing to reduce tail latency. Canary 3% for 30m during the 14:00-15:00 quiet window. Please ACK if you're watching.

deploy-bot: [automated] queued change 1791239999 - author: morgan - type: config-only - targets: routing-service,inference-proxy - canary: 3% for 30m - manifest snippet:
```yaml
routing_policy: prefer-latency
batching:
  max_batch_size: 48
  max_wait_ms: 12
timeouts:
  request_ms: 6000
  kvcache_ttl_ms: 120000
tenant_exclude: []
```

ana: ack — I'll watch p50/p95/p99 and error rates on the usual dashboards (https://console.redwood/obs/d/latency-overview).

jamal: small ask: exclude `qa-internal` from the canary (we still have perf tests hitting it).

morgan: good call — updating tenant_exclude to [qa-internal, perf-tests] before promote.

deploy-bot: promoted canary -> 3% (routes patched). Alerting threshold: p99 +20% or 5xx rate >5% triggers auto-pause.

sylvie: spotted an uptick in p99 in eu-west within the first 5m (roughly +28%). seeing `error: connection timeout to grpc-deps` in the inference-proxy logs. lowering canary to 1% and pausing further promotion.

morgan: pausing. initiating rollback for the canary slice to restore baseline while we triage. runbook command: `deploy-bot rollback 1791239999 --scope canary`

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for change 1791239999 - canary routes restored to baseline. Telemetry will reconcile in ~2m.

ops-oncall: tagging — I'll escalate to infra if errors don't normalize in 10m. leaving page open.

ana: after we stabilize, suggestion: instead of lowering `request_ms`, try reducing `max_wait_ms` to 8ms to avoid head-of-line amplification on long requests. Also consider geo-limited canary to eu-west only.

morgan: agreed. closing this rollout for now. I'll update the change log/release notes and open a follow-up config PR to try `max_wait_ms: 8` with a 1% eu-west canary. Thanks for the quick eyes everyone :thumbsup:

[sidenote] morgan: release note line to add: "tweak: reduce batching max_wait to reduce token tail latency; gated canary; rollback observed in eu-west — follow-up will iterate with geo-limited test.""
